verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own integration docs say it maps users and checks whether someone who still has access has offboarded. That covers the 'every leaver lost access' half of the story, but only through one thin integration mention. Nothing in the pack shows HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists or proof that new hires completed training. Missing for 10: HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists, tracking of training completion for new hires, documented access-revocation workflows beyond a single integration note, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access

citations.quote: It helps Sprinto to map and check if the user with access offboards the organization.
